output.summary: The cadence slip is best explained by a capacity bottleneck at the SEC-POL-14 security gate. One AppSec reviewer does about 4.4 reviews a week against 5 to 8 submissions a week. Squad-controlled stages are unchanged, and the added ~37 days sit between QA pass and AppSec sign-off. A full-time delegate in August cleared the queue and six releases shipped. Non-gated Reporting patches stayed at 14 days with the same squads, CI and process. PR, commit and story-point output and tech-debt measures are flat. So discipline, tech debt and reviewer slowness are contradicted. Morale is a downstream effect with a compensation-freeze confounder. Raise review capacity now. Do not run the accountability program or suspend the gate. Risk-tiering is premature until review outcomes and defect data exist (Q1, Q2).
